name: capacitor-kotlin-multi-platform-umbrella
description: Umbrella Capacitor plugin built on capacitor-kotlin-multi-platform: several KMP features (device info, motion) in one Kotlin framework
author: Dave Alden

scripts.verify: npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:web
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.kmp:build: cd kmp && ./gradlew capacitorExport && cd .. && node scripts/sync-from-base.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run prettier -- --check && npm run swiftlint -- lint ios/Sources ios/Tests Package.swift
scripts.fmt: npm run eslint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write && npm run swiftlint -- --fix --format ios/Sources ios/Tests Package.swift
scripts.docgen: docgen --api KmpDevicePlugin --output-readme docs/KmpDevice.md && docgen --api KmpMotionPlugin --output-readme docs/KmpMotion.md --output-json dist/docs.json
scripts.build: npm run kmp:build && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm run clean && npm run docgen && tsc && node scripts/copy-kmp-js.mjs && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
